*Cittasaṁsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiduka* (Patthana 8.44) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final book of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka. The text applies conditional relations (*paccaya*) to the Abhidhamma dyad concerning phenomena that are conjoined with, originated by, and consecutive to or accompanying consciousness (*cittasaṁsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattino dhammā*).
